newsitem.title: USA: Delta seen with less-than-expected profits.
newsitem.headline: Delta seen with less-than-expected profits.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc's profits for the quarter ending June 30 will fall short of earlier forecasts because of a re-enacted U.S. excise tax and buoyant growth in the low-yielding leisure sector of the travel industry, analysts said on Tuesday.

Analysts at three Wall Street brokerage firms reduced earnings per share estimates for Delta's fiscal fourth-quarter after the carrier warned that unit revenue growth would not meet expectations because of lower passenger mile yields.
